relations.subject: 14th Dalai Lama
relations.evidence: Trulshik Rinpoche Ngawang Chökyi Lodrö ('khrul zhig ngag dbang chos kyi blo gros) (1 January 1923 – 2 September 2011) born in Yardrok Taklung, Central Tibet was one of the main teachers of the 14th Dalai Lama

relations.subject: Sogyal Rinpoche
relations.evidence: one of the main teachers of the 14th Dalai Lama and of many of the younger generation of Nyingma lamas today including Sogyal Rinpoche

relations.subject: Trulshik Rinpoche Ngawang Chökyi Lodrö
relations.evidence: Trulshik Rinpoche founded the monastery of Thubten Chöling in Nepal.

relations.subject: Trulshik Rinpoche Ngawang Chökyi Lodrö
relations.evidence: In 2010 he became the official head of the Nyingma school.

relations.subject: Taklung Tsetrul Rinpoche
relations.role: official head of the Nyingma school
relations.evidence: Trulshik Rinpoche died on September 2, 2011, and was succeeded by Taklung Tsetrul Rinpoche who accepted the position on 22 March 2012.
